suite: MECT Systematic Donation Journey E2E Suite

tests.name: 1. Route /donate loads successfully with PageHero and Institutional Notice
2. Systematic 7-Step Navigation Indicator renders all 7 steps
3. Step 1 renders all 6 verified institutional programmes with radio selection
4. Unauthenticated donor continues to Step 2 (Donor Verification & Account)
5. Step 2 validates mobile/email format and handles OTP dispatch UI
6. Step 3 (Donor Details) renders with prefill and input validation
7. Step 4 (Contribution Amount) offers preset pills and custom input validation
8. Step 5 (Review Contribution Summary) displays verified donor & allocation details
9. Step 6 strictly enforces gateway visibility policy (HIM & Cashfree dormant, SBI remittance active)
10. Copy-to-clipboard buttons function for Account, IFSC, and UPI ID
11. Step 6 UTR submission transitions to Step 7 (Confirmation) with statutory tracking reference
12. URL query parameter ?programme=WATER preselects Water programme
